biome.name: Magma
biome.description: Constant eruptions keep this planet covered in lava flows and utterly inhospitable to Democratic life. It also makes it a treasure trove of rare minerals.

hazards.name: None
hazards.description: This planet's environment is not yet known, or has no environmental modifiers.

tacticalActions.name: EAGLE STORM
tacticalActions.description: DSS crews maintain deployment of a 24-hour rotating fleet of Eagle Fighters from the massive three-tiered Convocation Bay, supporting all Helldiver operations on the planet with close air support and slowing enemy offensives.
tacticalActions.strategicDescription: Eagle Gas Strikes during missions. Slows enemy progress in Defense Campaigns.

tacticalActions.name: ORBITAL BLOCKADE
tacticalActions.description: The DSS activates its Zero G Anti-Ship Missile System, targeting all large enemy spacecraft attempting to exit the planet's atmosphere. In addition, diverts excess manpower to Super Destroyer logistical support.
tacticalActions.strategicDescription: Defense Campaigns cannot originate from this planet. The Hellpod Space Optimization Booster is automatically active for all missions.

tacticalActions.name: HEAVY ORDNANCE DISTRIBUTION
tacticalActions.description: The DSS Logistics Armada supplies all Super Destroyers orbiting the planet with surplus 380mm shells. Ordnance support is also provided to SEAF operations, accelerating liberation efforts.
tacticalActions.strategicDescription: Orbital 380mm HE Barrage stratagem during missions. Accelerates progress in Liberation Campaigns.>
